title: Sketches for Dinosaur Parade
content: I did a lot of sketches before painting "Dinosaur Parade."I interpreted the scene in a variety of techniques:  red chalk & charcoal, pencil & wash, markers, and oil.What would the scene look like from high up on a balcony, or from a child's perspective, looking up?There are probably 100 more like these, all drawn purely from the imagination.Once I decided on the composition, I located maquettes, models,costumes, and reference photos to help me visualize the complete scene.The painting appears inDinotopia: A Land Apart from Time.
